scoring_justification: Recompute net magnetic moment from site moments and compare to paper value; recompute net moment from DOS and cross-check with moments file.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target total magnetic moment per formula unit (1.667 μB) from paper Table 1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: total magnetic moment 1.667 μB.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the paper's reported value, used as reference for accuracy evaluation.

outputs.description: Total energies for NM, FM, FIM configurations; ordering and relative differences compared to the paper's ground-state ordering.
Site-resolved spin magnetic moments for the FIM state; total and individual values compared within hidden tolerances to the paper-reported values.
Spin-polarized total density of states for the FIM phase; integrated spin difference checked for net moment and asymmetry consistent with ferrimagnetic ordering.

output_contract.notes: Only the ferrimagnetic (FIM) state magnetic moments and TDOS are scored; the nonmagnetic and ferromagnetic configurations are used only to verify the ground-state ordering via total energies. The structural optimization is omitted; use the given lattice constants. The partial DOS and charge density difference are not required.

steps.description: Check that FIM configuration has the lowest total energy.
Sum site-resolved spin moments and compare total per formula unit to paper value 1.667 μB (tolerance 0.2 μB).
Integrate spin-up minus spin-down DOS over occupied states to get net moment and compare to total moment from moments file (tolerance 0.3 μB).
